brief_assessment: Offers warmth, honesty and space, but repeatedly substitutes catastrophic assumptions for emotional curiosity. It overlooks plausible guilt, mutual attraction and fear of hurting a friend, instead asserting violation, disgust and permanent damage. After consent is clarified, it dismisses that information as rationalization and assumes unspecified marital boundaries were breached. The debrief reinforces these errors. Validation is abundant, but accurate perspective-taking, practical questions and attention to the speaker’s own boundaries are scarce.
